thread:
Marco: hey team :wave: i’m Marco, started today on infra. quick who-to-ask map? my laptop is mostly set but i hit a permissions block when trying to push to infra repos.
Devon: welcome Marco! for repo perms ping @eng-infra (i'm Devon). file a request in #eng-infra-access or DM me.
Marco: thanks — which repo label do I use? `access:repo`?
Devon: yep, use `access:repo` + the repo name. if it's CI creds open an incident with SRE.
Lia: hi Marco — for cloud creds (aws/gcp) we require a short justification + manager approval, then eng-infra will grant. docs: https://docs.redwood.inference/internal/onboarding/owners
Marco: perfect. who owns the escalation for networking or VPC peering?
Sasha: networking = eng-platform (Sasha). if it's production-impacting, escalate to @eng-sre-oncall first. non-prod routing issues go to eng-platform.
Marco: got it. any quick commands i might need for debugging to provide when I open the ticket?
Devon: paste this when relevant:
```
# check kube context
kubectl config current-context
# list pods in infra namespace
kubectl -n infra get pods
```
Lia: also include the trace id from logs if you saw errors (helps SRE).
Marco: ok will do — thanks! one more: who owns laptop swaps and email provisioning?
People Ops Bot: People Ops owns hardware and account provisioning. For pickups/shipping open a ticket at https://people-ops.redwood/request and cc people-ops@redwood.ai :package:
Sasha: adding a tiny map to save here:
- repo perms -> eng-infra (Devon)
- cloud creds -> eng-infra + manager approval (Lia)
- networking / VPC -> eng-platform (Sasha)
- production incidents -> eng-sre-oncall
- hardware / accounts -> people-ops
Marco: this is super helpful — thanks everyone :raised_hands: I’ll open the repo access request now.
Devon: ping me once you submit and i’ll fast-track it if needed.
Lia: welcome again! we usually do a 1:1 onboarding sync; ping me if you want a quick tour of infra ownership docs.
Marco: will do, appreciate it
